relay_patrol_alert: ^Narrator: She comes round the end of the inverter cabinets mid-stride and stops dead.
^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Inverter room's closed. Has been all week.
^Three charge stations, all bypassed. Was that you?

c-0: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': *already reaching for the radio* Because I'm meant to be.
c-1: ^Narrator: Her hand stops halfway. She weighs it, and leaves the radio where it is.
c-2: ^Narrator: That stops her more effectively than the first option would have. She had not expected anyone to have looked.

relay_alerts_team: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': All units, inverter room. We have company.
^Narrator: She clips the radio back on her belt with the unhurried confidence of someone who expects to win this.
relay_standoff: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': You're not getting to those rack banks.
^I don't need to. I need you to understand what they'll do.
^Walk away. I'm not here for you.

c-1: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': *shakes her head, almost friendly* No, you're really not going to be able to do that.

relay_doubt: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Thermal runaway in a sealed hall. I know exactly what they'll do.
^Narrator: There is no flinch in it. She is not a technician who was lied to; she costed this and came anyway.
^You modelled the casualties and came anyway.
^Then you know the night crew is still in Hall 2.

c-0: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': The casualties were a line in the same spreadsheet.
c-1: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': *beat* They were told to clear at midnight.
^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': If they didn't, that's on them.

relay_refuses: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Last chance to be somewhere else.
relay_down: ^Narrator: She is down against the base of an inverter cabinet, one arm across her ribs, still doing arithmetic behind her eyes.

c-0: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Four. Cipher, me, Static, Voltage.
^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': If you got this far you've met Cipher.
^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Voltage won't yield. Don't plan around it.
c-1: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Charge stations. Three of them, in here.
^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Bypass hardware on all three, remote controllable. You'd have to physically pull them.
c-2:
^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': *closes her eyes* Blackout signs the models.

^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Voltage just runs the site.

relay_secure_her: ^Narrator: You tie her off to the cabinet frame and lift the master card from her jacket.
relay_secured_hub: ^Narrator: Relay is secured against the inverter cabinet, watching the hydrogen panel more than she watches you.

c-0: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Four. Voltage is the one that matters.
c-1: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Three charge stations, in here. Pull them by hand.
c-2: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': *watching the panel* Amber's not the one to worry about.
